notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build date or height, so the record's 1975 build year and 18.3 m height are unverified and left out of facts. The Forest Lookouts page has only the county label for this tower. County conflict: record and Forest Lookouts say Berks; the 2001 Morning Call walk guide says Schuylkill. Needs a human check before publication. Do not use the ArcGIS Fire Towers of Pennsylvania snippet that says 'Built in 1975' by Aermotor: it describes a different tower in Michaux State Forest, Franklin County. Komoot is undated, and its closed status is the only current-condition source. Record agency Weiser State Forest is supported only by the DCNR entrance sign.
